name: Point shot
caption: Your LD has the puck at the left point with a clear look and is winding up to shoot. Their goalie can see it. You're on the right half-wall.

questions.prompt: Your LD is about to shoot. What do you do?

options.text: Drive to the far post, stick on the ice, timing it so I arrive as the shot comes.
options.feedback: That is where rebounds go on a shot from the left. The goalie is moving left to right; the far post is behind his momentum.

options.text: Get in front of the goalie for a screen.
options.feedback: Your center and left wing are already in front. A third screen blocks your own shot more than the goalie. The far post is empty; go there.

options.text: Stay on the half-wall as the high safety option.
options.feedback: That is your RD’s job. Only hold if your RD has pinched below you; otherwise you are watching from a spot with no rebound in it.

options.text: Go to the corner to pick up the puck if it misses.
options.feedback: A missed shot that rims comes to the half-wall, not the corner, and it is their D who are closest. Rebounds in front are the real chance.

questions.prompt: Tap where you want to be when the shot arrives.
questions.label: Far post

fb.right: Far post, stick on the ice. On a shot from the left, the rebound comes out to the right.
fb.close: Nearly. Tighter to the post and a touch deeper; you want the goalie’s blind side, not the top of the crease.
fb.wrong: The screen is taken. Rebounds from a left-point shot kick out to the right post, so that is where you go.
